answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow: each agent posts a $40 deposit and gets a jade seal logging its fingerprint over 10 epochs. A new identity starts at its nadir, trusted for nothing, unlocking only as it proves distinct. Clones betray themselves: 1,000 copies share near-identical fingerprints, so similarity above 85% slashes every deposit — $40,000 lost; no juniper grows overnight. Honest agents pay $40 once and unlock after 10 clean epochs.
